info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Underwriting Id-spec
info.description: This API allows users to modify existing sale records associated with a specific underwriting ID. It is designed for financial institutions and insurance companies that need to update sale details, such as status, amount, or other relevant attributes. Typical consumers of this API include administrators and automated systems that manage underwriting processes and sales reporting. By providing a seamless way to make updates, this API enhances operational efficiency and data accuracy in transaction management.

patch.summary: Update the underwriting details for a specific sales resource.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the underwriting information associated with the sales resource identified by RES-100045. You can update various details to reflect the current status or changes in underwriting criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to partially update the underwriting details for the specified sale identified by RES-100045. The provided data should follow the defined schema and include only the fields that need to be updated.

200.description: Request completed successfully and resource has been updated.
